steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, I've received a special visit request. The visitors are already at the Bureau.

options: Ask about their identities and purpose

choices.text: Ask about their identities and purpose

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: They claim to be Lynn's parents and insist on meeting Sinner Lynn.
Having studied the Sinner's background, you know that Lynn's parents are both ordinary people. If they've already been permitted entry, they most likely won't pose any threat to the Bureau.
...Then let's arrange for a meeting.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Got it, I'll see to it immediately.
Lynn, follow me. I have to take you somewhere.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: What's the matter, Chief? Oh... Can I go to Syndicate for a photoshoot again?
Lynn looks at you excitedly, anticipating another outdoor photoshoot. To reward Lynn for training diligently, you've promised to take her out for photos whenever she meets a goal.
We're doing something else.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Wh-what?
Your parents have come to visit you. The FAC has permitted entry to them, they're in the reception room now.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Um... My dad and mom... have come to the Bureau...?
Lynn is stunned, her joyful mood suddenly dampened.
I remember you once told me your parents cared about you a lot. I've thought about it, and I think you probably... should see each other.
Don't you want them to know how you've been doing?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I, I miss them a lot too... but...
She raises her hand to touch the helmet, then drops it as though it stings her.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: It's just that... The way I am now, I don't know how to face them...
You've promised me to start over. Making your family understand you is an important part of that too.
But of course, I respect your choice, though I truly hope you can take that step.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: That's... true...
She mumbles, still extremely hesitant.

options: Do you want me to go with you?

choices.text: Do you want me to go with you?

steps.content: Will you feel less nervous if someone's there to share the stress with you?
Lynn nods thankfully.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: In that case... If you don't mind, Chief...
You take Lynn to the reception room. A plainly dressed middle-aged couple is already waiting there.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Dad... Mom... You've really come...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: Lynn...? It's you... I can tell from your voice, it's you!
Seeing Lynn, the woman jumps up immediately but stumbles and almost falls. Luckily, her husband catches her in time.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: Hey, careful...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: Lynn, since you've gone missing, your mom and I have asked everywhere and everyone to look for you... We were almost out of our minds!

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: Thank god... Now that we know you're safe, we can finally relax.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Dad... Your hair's turned gray... And your back looks more hunched now...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Mom too... You look different... You've got more crow's feet around your eyes...
Spotting the haggardness in her parents, Lynn feels guilty.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Is it all... because of me...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Sob... Sorry... I've made you so worried...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: All that matters is that we've found you. It's all in the past now...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: How have you been, living outside all by yourself? Are you eating well? Have you got enough clothes?

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: Whenever I think of my daughter living like a nomad somewhere I don't know, I just...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...I, I'm fine, Mom!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: The Bureau has taken me in now. Chief and the others are very nice to me, I... feel very satisfied...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: But... Lynn, if you're doing well, why are you wearing this... helmet?
Lynn's mother looks at Lynn's helmet, puzzled.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: Take it off, let me see your face, sweetheart...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: No, no...!
Flustered, Lynn dodges her mother's hand trying to touch the helmet.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: After that incident... My body has become very dangerous... I must wear the helmet to keep it under control...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: But I'm already working on it... working on taking it off... Don't worry...
Hearing that, Lynn's mother bows her head and wipes the corner of her eye. It pains her to see her daughter like this.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: I told you... Why must you resist in the first place?

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: Look what it's cost you...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...Huh?
Just reaching out to wipe her mother's tears, Lynn's hand freezes in the air. Her mother looks up with a sorrowful expression, her tears filled with silent confusion and protest.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: If you'd been more tolerant and hadn't provoked them, perhaps all this wouldn't have happened...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: The three of us could have continued living together peacefully...
Next to her, Lynn's father nods in agreement.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: Your mom is right.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: We didn't work so hard to send you to school in Eastside for you to mess with those Eastsiders!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I didn't...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: Because of our status, we've always been vulnerable. If we hadn't lived humbly all this time, we would have been kicked back to Syndicate long ago...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: People envied us for moving to Eastside. Why do you never treasure the life you have?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I never asked for...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: We've worked so hard to lay a better foundation for your future, but you... Sigh!
After being cut off a few times, Lynn falls silent and doesn't speak anymore. You begin to feel worried.
You thought this would be a touching reunion of daughter and parents. You didn't know this was how Lynn's parents showed their care.
Just when you want to say something to lighten the mood, Lynn suddenly speaks again.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...But, Dad, Mom.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Did you know... what they did to me?
Lynn says with a trembling voice, wringing her hands.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: They... mocked me. They even took all my photos and tore them up one by one before my eyes... shredded them...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: They insulted me while tearing up my photos, shouting... A Syndican scum will always be a scum, even if they're here in Eastside, they still reek of Syndicate...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: They even... They even tried to take away my camera!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I couldn't take it anymore, so I grappled with them... But I was too weak, so very soon... I got pushed down on the floor...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: To punish me, they said they would give me a... lesson of a lifetime...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: At that time... My eye hurt, it hurt so much I thought I was going to die...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Even if I've... suffered such horrible torture... you still think I should keep on enduring it?
Lynn's aggrieved confession rains down like needles. Even you feel a pang in your heart.
Lynn's parents are shocked. It's the first time they've heard Lynn's account of the incident. They never knew their daughter had endured such pain.
Lynn's mother opens her mouth, wanting to console her poor daughter. But somehow when the words come out, they turn into something else.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: But... but isn't it because you're not good enough?

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: Otherwise, why wouldn't they bully somebody else... just you?

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: Right... You're an Eastsider now, why do you still go to Syndicate, that filthy place, for your photos? Isn't Eastside pretty enough for you?
As he goes on with his scolding, Lynn's father spots Lynn's beloved camera that she always keeps beside her. He points at it and says ruefully.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: If I'd known it would cause all these troubles... I never would have given you this darn camera!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...What?
Lynn can't believe her ears.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: We taught you to be tolerant, it's all for your own good... Why won't you listen to us...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: Your dad and I have been through that too. That's the only way newcomers like us can find happiness...
Seeing Lynn's paling knuckles, you know her delicate mind can no longer stand more of this interrogation in the guise of love.
Excuse me... Sir, Madam, may I say something?
Regarding your point of view, I beg to differ.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: Pardon me, you're?
I'm the Chief of this Bureau, in a way... I'm Lynn's supervisor now.
Learning your title, a humble look appears on Lynn's father's face.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: Please go on...
I don't think blind tolerance can bring you happiness.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Mr... Chief?
Not expecting you to chime in, Lynn tugs at the hem of your shirt.
You assure her with a smile, then turn back to the middle-aged couple and continue seriously.
The best support a child can get is from their parents.
But when Lynn asked you for help, not only did you not offer her any, you even told her to succumb to the bullies.
Do you really believe that can change the way they treat Lynn?
Lynn's parents gawk at you in shock, as if you've just given some groundbreaking speech.
An abuser will gain even more pleasure from a weak victim.
The meeker the victim, the crueler the abuser becomes.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: But other than enduring it, there's nothing else we can do...
You shake your head wryly.
No, there's a lot you can do.
For instance, you can report it to the teachers or the police, or even stop this kind of behavior yourselves.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: We're powerless in Eastside... Even if we do that, they're not going to give up!
What about transferring to a new school? Switch to a brand new, safe environment.
Even if you can't do any of these, you should at the very least tell Lynn not to believe what those people say.
If you'd actually made Lynn feel that her parents truly wanted to protect her from these people... Perhaps, the following incident wouldn't have happened at all.
Lynn's father's shoulders slump. He can't say anything to refute you. Maybe he's finally realized his cowardice now, but it's already too late.
Only Lynn's mother's intermittent sobs fill the reception room.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...That's enough, Chief. Thank you for speaking up for me.
Lynn breaks the suffocating silence once again. She clenches her fists, suddenly looking very solemn.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Dad, Mom... I've never told you this before.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I... actually don't like Eastside that much. It's certainly a glamorous, prosperous city... but it doesn't welcome me.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Although you've always told me that tolerance brings happiness, it's never been the case for me... All I feel is oppression.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Except when... I take photos.
The second she brings up her favorite activity, the hesitation in Lynn's tone vanishes completely, as if it's brought her strength.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Even if my object is Syndicate, a place which everyone looks down upon, I still feel so free, so content...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I... I've made up my mind. I'd rather quit Eastside than continue to live that kind of... depressing life...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Not to mention... I'm a Sinner now. If you can't accept my changes and insist that I live like I did in the past...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Then... I might as well just...
Lynn draws in a deep breath, as though she's going to make a very important decision.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Chief, I've heard that... the FAC can exercise a kind of... memory intervention to Sinners' families. It's called the Affiliate Protection Program, right?
You're not sure why Lynn suddenly brings that up, but you still answer her.
Indeed. But nowadays, as long as their family members abide by the NDA, the FAC will not resort to that kind of intrusive measures.
Memory intervention was indeed part of the Affiliate Protection Program. But due to its severe side effects on the human body, it's no longer a compulsory procedure now.
Hearing your affirmative answer, Lynn nods.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I see... Then, could my parents... receive memory intervention?

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: ...Lynn! What are you talking about?!
Lynn's mother screams frantically, grabbing Lynn's hands in disbelief.
Lynn pats her mother on the back of her hand and convinces her gently.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Mom... Just forget me...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: That way... You and Dad can keep on living a peaceful life...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: It's for your own good too...
You are surprised by Lynn's determination. This is her "rebellion" after years of silence.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Could you use the shackles on me... Chief?

options: What do you want to do?

choices.text: What do you want to do?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: If my parents want to see the real me... then I'll show them.
Lynn's attitude is so determined that you can't refuse.
Lynn takes off the helmet and lifts her head to stare straight at her shocked parents, the scar on her right eye still clearly visible.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: After I became like this... I thought I only deserved a life in the sewers, that I had no such thing as a future...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: But Chief... He's proven to me with his action that I still deserve the hope to start over...
steps.female_content: But Chief... She's proven to me with her action that I still deserve the hope to start over...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: That's why I've decided to stay by Chief's side... and to learn to control my power. From now on... I'll live my life in my own way...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: That's... all I want to tell you.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: ...I'm sorry, Lynn.
Lynn's father wipes his eyes and begins bitterly.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: You are right... We've indeed failed Lynn as her parents...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: We want you to have a happy life, but the love we give you is self-righteous. In the end, it's we who made our daughter suffer...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: I'm in fact... the worst parent...
Lynn's father is still overwhelmed by regrets when next to him, her mother reaches out a hand to touch Lynn's scar warily. When Lynn doesn't resist, her mother hugs her gently.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: Lynn... Have you made up your mind?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Yes... Mom.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: I see...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: If you've decided to do it... This time, I'll support you no matter what.
Lynn's eyes widen in shock.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: I hope... you can choose the life you want. No need to listen to us anymore...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: But likewise, we won't listen to you either. We won't agree to the memory intervention.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: Our daughter is trying so hard to improve. As parents, why can't we learn to change too?
Her fingers keep tracing her daughter's features, wanting to carve Lynn's face in her heart.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: We'll never ever want to forget you...
Lynn's father comes over and embraces his wife and daughter in his arms.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: That's the last thing we want, Lynn...

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: No matter what you become, you'll always be our beloved daughter...
In her family's embrace, a bright smile finally shines on Lynn's face.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Dad, Mom... Thank you...
You smile thankfully at the scene. When you're ready to exit quietly and leave the family some space, Lynn's mother stops you.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: ...Your Excellency.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: I know this is not a place where ordinary people can enter casually. I don't know how much time and effort it'll take to arrange another visit for us.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: But still, I'd like to ask if we could see Lynn again?
Lynn also looks at you expectantly, waiting for an answer anxiously.
Indeed, ordinary people and Sinners should not be in frequent contact.
Before Lynn's eyes dim completely, you switch your tone.
But I've promised Lynn that when she meets a training goal, I'll take her out for a photoshoot.
If you can really keep your promise and change, then the next time I take Lynn to Syndicate, I'll notify you.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Chief...!
Lynn cries out in surprise.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Mother
steps.content: Your Excellency... Thank you, thank you very much... We'll keep our promise...!

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: Lynn, looks like the three of us will have to work hard together.

steps.speaker: Lynn's Father
steps.content: We'll do our best for a chance to meet you again!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...Me too!
